text:
amanda (procurement): Heads-up: GlobeFreight just pushed an alert on AWB GF-3003. Mixed H200/A800 shipment, partial unload at EU gateway tomorrow 03:15 UTC (arrival manifest shows 34 units). Remainder ~56 expected in ~72 hours. Customs flagged possible HS reclass and duty variance. Need quick decision: accept partial + air-topup or pay expedite via FRA. Also vendor reports 4 soft-DOA flags on initial QC. @globe-freight what's the duty impact and options?

globe-freight (supply-broker): Quick summary: customs queried HS between 8471.80 and 8542.31. Estimated additional duty ~ $1,320. Options: (A) Accept partial and wait for remainder 3 days (no extra fee) but miss staging window if <40. (B) FRA expedited clearance, fee +$310, clears same day. (C) Air-topup 6 units to hit staging min (costly, ~ $1,350 + sourcing time). Regarding 4 soft-DOA: we can supply PDF 4x6 return labels and photo evidence. Vendor can either absorb duty delta in full if Redwood signs a 3-month price lock (-$50/unit) on next committed allocation, or provide $300/unit credit for the 4 soft-fails and we cover duties. Portal: https://globefreight.example/awb/GF-3003

raj (fleet): Staging threshold = 40. Partial 34 -> below. Losing the pool costs ops ~ $2,750 this week. Air-topup too expensive; reroute fee seems economical if vendor will absorb duty or waive fee.

syl (ops): Depot hard rule: DOA units without pre-created RMA + PDF labels => entire AWB quarantined. We need RMAs and labels before arrival. @rma-bot can you open provisional RMA and post depot checklist?

rma-bot: provisional RMA created: #RMA-43210 for AWB GF-3003. Depot requirements: 1) full serial manifest attached (CSV or inline), 2) return labels attached as PDF (4x6), 3) photo evidence for DOA units, 4) signed claim terms for vendor credit or DOA liability within 7 days. If PDF labels missing on arrival -> depot_quarantine = true. RMA status = pending_documents.

ida (finance): Quick back-of-envelope: Option B reroute + vendor absorbs duty = +$310 fee but duty $0 if they absorb. If vendor instead does $300/unit credit for 4 soft-fails that's $1,200 credit but we still pay $1,320 duty. Two scenarios: 1) Take vendor absorption (price lock): cost = $310 + lost margin from price lock unknown (need projection). 2) Take credits: net = $310 + $1,320 - $1,200 = $430 plus accounting churn. Which is cheaper depends on price lock cost. We need vendor to quantify revenue impact of -$50/unit for 3 months on next committed quantity.

amanda (procurement): Ask vendor to put the duty-absorb + price-lock offer in writing and to supply the exact units for the 6-unit uplift if they expect a commitment. We also need the 4 soft-fail serials and PDF return labels uploaded to RMA-43210 now. Legal needs amendment draft for the price-lock.

globe-freight (supply-broker): We can confirm in-thread: willing to absorb the $1,320 duty conditional on Redwood signing a 3-month price lock of -$50/unit on next committed allocation (min 200 units). We'll send a written amendment and the uplift serials (6 units) if Redwood accepts the price-lock. Uploaded provisional return_labels_RMA-43210.pdf and softfail_serials_GF-3003.csv to the RMA ticket. Amendment draft to follow in procurement channel. :white_check_mark:

syl (ops): Manifest snippet for depot reconciliation (vendor please reconcile full list when you upload):

AWB: GF-3003
partial units arriving (34):
- H200-PL-9001
- A800-PL-9002  (soft-fail QC)
- A800-PL-9003  (soft-fail QC)
- A800-PL-9004  (soft-fail QC)
- H200-PL-9005  (soft-fail QC)
- ... (total 34)

Reminder: depot will auto-quarantine if PDF labels not attached. rma-bot will toggle quarantine flag otherwise.

rma-bot: reminder: attach PDF 4x6 labels to RMA-43210 before arrival_time. If not attached, set depot_quarantine=true. RMA status = pending_documents.

raj (fleet): If vendor signs written duty absorb + amendment we'll reroute FRA and intake to staging. Procurement/legal please fast-track.

amanda (procurement): Noted. I'll coordinate with legal to review the amendment and with finance for the price-lock impact. If countersigned we'll instruct GlobeFreight to execute FRA reroute and confirm manifest patch for the +6 uplift serials.

globe-freight (supply-broker): Amendment draft uploaded to secure link and return_labels_RMA-43210.pdf is live. We'll also push the exact +6 uplift serials by EOD. Ping me if you need a redline. :thumbsup:
